reviews.text: Robert (Dog Boy) Haussmann has been a breath of fresh air. As a professional dog walker, I know how important it is to find the right trainer for our whole family. Dog Boy made us all feel at ease, most importantly, Theo Valentine (our 10-month-old Weimaraner-Boxer mix). It hasn't been easy, but the training has been consistent and has evolved at the right pace for all of us. My wife and I are extremely happy with DogBoy; he continues to raise our standards for Theo's development. I am happy to recommend DogBoy to all who need his expertise!

Dogboy is exceptional! Robert has a keen understanding of canine behavior and the behavioral training thus far for our rescue dog has been transformative. Robert listened to our training priorities and came up with a manageable and effective approach that suited our needs. He teaches dogs and humans with compassion, patience, understanding that is crucial to being a great trainer.  I cannot recommend him highly enough!

Our dog has participated in both group classes and solo behavior modification, and had a great time in class, and has made big strides with his behavior.  We especially appreciated the accommodations Robert and Jenny made for him in class so he could have enough physical space to feel safe around other dogs!  It was a big step in improving his confidence!

We love working with Robert, and our pups do, too! Robert is kind, respectful, and above all- knowledgeable. He taught us to be better owners with patient guidance and experience backed skillsets, which in turn built a safer & more peaceful home for our two dogs.

Jenny Lee is the most amazing trainer. She worked with me and my dog Gretel, who is a miniature Bernese Mountain Dog, when Gretel was a puppy. We worked on loose leash training because Gretel was pulling, commands, correcting her bad behavior and redirecting her and potty training. Gretel improved tremendously. Not only did Jenny teach me, she taught my two sons how to work with Gretel too! We worked from my house, the street and the dog park. I’d recommend her to absolutely anyone with a puppy or anyone wanting to use positive reinforcement techniques to help their dog listen. Wonderful experience!
Jenny Lee is amazing! She provided me with the tools to potty train my puppy, teach her tricks, and reduce her barking. I love her!

Had a wonderful training experience with DOGBOY! Jenny worked with us and our 11month old puppy. She was so kind, and not only did he love her, but he also respected her instructions, so we were able to learn so much!
We look forward to booking more sessions soon.

Benny and I have been working with Jenny for a few months since I adopted him. He has learned an incredible amount and is a different dog now! He adores Jenny and she is able to make so much progress within each hour. She explains everything so well and makes sure I have what I need to practice between sessions. So far we’ve mastered basic commands and loose leash walking, and are working on doorbell desensitization and separation anxiety tools. I would be lost without Jenny and could not recommend her more!

Jenny is an INCREDIBLE trainer. She worked patiently, consistently, methodically, joyfully, and sensitively with my rescue dog, Boots. Boots is challenging—she has a range of behavioral issues, including being territorial around food, reactive to sounds outside, having trouble settling down, and needing to learn a host of commands. Jenny made amazing progress with Boots—teaching her to orient towards a resting place, helping her decompress, giving her regulation tools when she gets reactive, helping us both to improve her leash and play manners, and on. Most importantly, it’s clear that Boots LOVES working work Jenny. She was always appropriately challenged and deeply engaged, focused, tail wagging. I couldn’t recommend Jenny more highly.

Robert was so helpful with the first weeks of puppy’s training. He has a ton of knowledge and skillfully helped us so we could help our young puppy be the best she could be! Robert was always on time and super friendly. And most importantly our puppy loved him!

Rob is a fantastic trainer, incredibly knowledgable about dogs and their psychology. He was also practical - giving us specific techniques to reduce and remove our dog's resource guarding impulses. I recommend DogBoy for any and all dog training / behavioral needs, whether the issue is small or large!

Robert was super knowledgeable and prepped us with information in a short amount of time, in a way that didn’t feel overwhelming. He did a great job of balancing tried and true protocols with recommendations specific to our dog, home, and circumstances. Would definitely recommend!

Robert has been life changing as we train a beloved and mischievious pup. He seems to have an intuitive way with dogs, and knows exactly how to guide us toward better manners & behavior. I like also that he is responsive to what we has her humans need to accomplish too. A joy to work with! Heartily recommend!

The Dogboy team is great! We worked with Robert to prep our dog for our baby's arrival. He helped a lot with training her to calm down and get less overly-excited. Our dog can be a bit anxious and he helped us focus on ways to reduce her stress and change her negative association with triggers.

This is the second time we have worked with Robert, the first time was a few years ago when we needed some guidance on recall and loose leash walking. He spends a lot of time explaining to owners how to interpret their dogs emotional state and how to help regulate it. To get the most out of sessions make sure to keep up with the homework and start building a good training routine, even if it's just a few minutes a day.

Happy to recommend Dogboy to anyone who needs extra help with their dog.

Jenny was an incredible trainer for our puppy! Even after just a few sessions, we noticed a huge improvement in our puppy’s responsiveness and behavior. She was knowledgeable, patient, and so great to work with throughout the process. We truly can’t recommend Jenny enough!

Jenny was so great with TT and really patient with us and our needs. We wanted to work on some techniques to help with a bit of her separation anxiety and helped to prepare us for an upcoming flight. TT responded will to going to her place and Jenny made it so easy. Thank so much!

Super happy with Jenny Lee, our trainer for the Basic Manners class with Dogboy NYC. She was very patient and generous with her knowledge. She does everything possible to make class enjoyable for both the human and puppy.
The facility itself is quite small - it is NYC after all and located in a boarding facility. It is clean and properly maintained but there is not a lot of room when class is full. Jenny gave us a success castle, which is an exercise pen covered by blankets, to minimize distractions around us. This was helpful since my pup has a hard time focusing because the world around him is just so exciting! So he could still hear and smell everyone around him, but gave him an opportunity to focus on the lessons. The space will have its own distractions too, as some of the dogs boarded will bark from time to time as class goes on. Something to keep in mind in case your pup is reactive or sound sensitive.
Jenny will do everything possible to make sure that your are set up for success. It was really great working with her.

Working with Jenny at Dogboy has been a total game-changer for our two husky mixes. Anyone with huskies knows how notoriously stubborn and dramatic they can be, but Jenny handled them with such expertise!

We specifically needed help with leash behavior and prey drive desensitization. Within just a few months, we’ve seen a massive shift in how they focus on us rather than every squirrel in Brooklyn. Jenny gave us the tools to feel confident and in control during our walks. She has been such a help for us and I can't recommend her enough as a trainer!

We worked with Jenny for our puppy, Zane. She was amazing! We learned so many useful commands including (place, touch, stay, etc.) She also shared so many great product recommendations like treats, harnesses, leashes, etc that we still use today.

We plan to continue working with Jenny as needed over Zane’s first 18 months of life, but six months in and we’re so grateful for the impact she has had!

Robert at Dogboy NYC is an exceptional dog trainer, and I can’t recommend him highly enough. From the moment we started, he was incredibly knowledgeable and explained everything in a way that was clear and easy to follow. He didn’t just work with my dog during the session—he gave me practical, useful tools that I could confidently apply at home.
My dog, Clio, took to him immediately, which says a lot about his calm and approachable demeanor. Before working with Robert, walking Clio on a leash was a complete nightmare. I was honestly shocked that after just one hour, she was like a completely different dog—calmer, more focused, and so much easier to handle.
He also helped us make great progress with essential commands like drop, come, and stay. What really stood out was how effective and efficient his methods were without ever feeling overwhelming.
If you’re looking for a trainer who truly understands dogs and knows how to teach owners just as well, Robert is the one to call.
